# Diagnostic codes

Every code the linter emits, paired with what it means and the canonical fix. The CLI / LSP / JSON output uses the `Code` column verbatim; consumers can match on these stable identifiers (with a `vale-` prefix on Vale-check alerts, e.g. `vale-vocabulary-ambiguousbare`).

| Code | Meaning | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `missing-frontmatter` | The file has no `---\n…\n---` YAML block. | Add a frontmatter block with `id`, `role`, `title`, `summary`, `status`, `updated`. |
| `parse-error` | The frontmatter YAML failed to parse. | Inspect the YAML for indentation, unquoted special characters, or a missing colon. |
| `missing-field` | A field listed in `required_fields` is absent from this doc's frontmatter. | Add the named field, or remove it from `required_fields` if the doc-set no longer needs it. |
| `yaml-scalar-truncated-by-comment` | An unquoted YAML scalar contains space-preceded `#`, which YAML 1.2 parses as a comment start — the value is silently truncated at that position. | Wrap the value in double quotes (or single quotes if the text contains `"`). Common trigger: PR / issue references like `since #225` in unquoted summaries. |
| `legacy-type-field` | The doc uses the pre-ontology `type:` field instead of `role:` / `kind:` / `lifecycle:`. | Run `doc-linter migrate-ontology` or rewrite the frontmatter to use the current axes. |
| `unknown-role` | The `role:` value doesn't match any value doc under `docs/ontology/values/role/`. | Either add a value doc at `docs/ontology/values/role/<name>.md` or correct the role to one of the registered values. |
| `unknown-axis-value` | An axis value (e.g. `kind:` / `lifecycle:`) doesn't match its axis vocabulary. | Add a value doc for the new axis term, or pick one of the existing values. |
| `missing-axis-field` | The doc's role requires an axis (e.g. `kind` for `role: doc`) that isn't declared. | Add the missing axis to the frontmatter, or change `role:` to one that doesn't require it. |
| `lifecycle-not-allowed-for-role` | The combination of `role:` and `lifecycle:` is rejected by the ontology. | Pick a lifecycle value the role allows, or extend the axis vocabulary to permit this pairing. |
| `filename-pattern-mismatch` | The filename doesn't match the role's required regex (e.g. `roadmap-entry` requires `^\d+-.*\.md$`). | Rename the file to match. |
| `wrong-folder` | The doc matched a `[[layout_rules]]` entry but lives outside its `allowed_paths`. | `git mv` the file to the suggested path, or extend the layout entry's `allowed_paths`. |
| `unknown-entity` | A `covers:` value isn't a registered entity. | Add `docs/ontology/entities/<id>.md`, or correct the spelling to an existing entity id. |
| `unknown-bounded-context` | The `bounded_context:` value isn't a registered value doc under `docs/ontology/values/bounded-context/`. | Add a value doc for the new context, or pick one of the existing values. |
| `wrong-bounded-context-field` | An entity wrote `bounded_context:` or a non-entity doc wrote `bounded_contexts:`; the value is ignored. | Entities use the `bounded_contexts: [..]` list, every other doc the `bounded_context: <value>` string. Rename the field. |
| `invalid-status` | `status:` isn't in `allowed_statuses` (default: draft / stable / archived / deprecated / candidate). | Pick an allowed status, or extend `allowed_statuses` in `.doc-lint.toml`. |
| `invalid-visibility` | `visibility:` isn't in `allowed_visibility` (default: public / internal / private). | Pick an allowed visibility, or extend `allowed_visibility` in `.doc-lint.toml`. |
| `updated-in-future` | `updated:` is a date strictly later than today. | Set `updated:` to today or earlier — future-dating defeats staleness queries. |
| `duplicate-id` | Two docs declare the same `id:`. | Rename one of the docs' `id:` fields; the linker resolves wikilinks by id and a collision breaks every reference. |
| `id-mismatch` | `id:` doesn't match the doc's filename stem. | Rename the file or change `id:` so the two agree. |
| `broken-wikilink` | `[[target]]` doesn't resolve to a doc id or filename stem. | Fix the target id, or add the missing doc. |
| `broken-md-link` | A markdown link `[label](path.md)` points at a non-existent doc. | Fix the path — common cause: file moved and the link wasn't updated. |
| `broken-file-link` | A non-`.md` link target doesn't exist on disk. | Fix the path, or add the file the link references. |
| `broken-typed-edge` | A typed-edge frontmatter field (e.g. `depends_on:`, `informed_by:`, `supersedes:`) references an unknown doc id. | Correct the target id, or remove the typed edge if the relationship no longer holds. |
| `unlinked-path` | Inline backtick text looks like a file path but isn't a markdown link. | Convert to `[label](path)`, or add the text to `unlinked_path_exempt` if it's a convention reference. |
| `orphan-doc` | A doc with frontmatter has no inbound or outbound graph edges. | Link to/from at least one other doc, or set `lifecycle: archived` if it's truly standalone. |
| `vale-missing` | The `vale` binary isn't on PATH; vocab-closure was skipped for this run. | Install Vale (`brew install vale` / `cargo install vale`), or set `vale_enabled = false` to silence. |
| `vocab-dictionary-unreadable` | A `vale_dictionaries` entry points at a file that can't be read; its terms are missing from every vocab accept list. | Fix the path in `.doc-lint.toml` (it's relative to the repo root) or remove the entry. |
| `vale-failed` | `vale` is installed but exited with a runtime error, so vocab-closure did not run. | Run the `vale` command from the message by hand and fix what it reports (bad style, unreadable file), or pass --no-vale. |
| `vale-alert` | A Vale check fired (one of `Vocabulary.*`, `Style.*`, etc.) that the post-processor didn't downgrade. | Fix the prose, add the term to `vale_extra_accept`, or extend Vale's vocab dictionaries. |
| `cross-context-reference` | A bare noun resolved to an entity in a different bounded context than this doc's. | Fully qualify with `[[entity-id]]`, rephrase to a non-colliding term, or move the doc to the matching context. |
| `comment-vocab-violation` | A capitalised token in a `///` doc-comment doesn't resolve to a known entity. | Add the entity, rephrase the comment, or add the term to `code_comment_extra_accept`. |
| `missing-anchor` | A public-API doc-comment in an `anchor_required_in` crate doesn't reference any ontology entity or roadmap id. | Add a `[[entity-foo]]` (or `[[roadmap-N]]`) wikilink to the comment. |
| `scip-indexer-missing` | `rust-analyzer` isn't on PATH; the SCIP index step was skipped. | Install `rust-analyzer`, or set `scip_required = false` to silence. |
| `scip-stale` | `<root>/.doc-lint/code.scip` is older than the newest `.rs` file. | Run `doc-linter scip-index` (or rebuild the index manually). |
| `scip-missing` | `scip_required = true` but `<root>/.doc-lint/code.scip` is absent. | Run `doc-linter scip-index`, or set `scip_required = false`. |
| `self-loop` | A doc declares a typed-edge frontmatter field that points at itself. | Remove the self-reference — typed edges always cross between docs. |
| `superseded-without-successor` | A doc with `lifecycle: superseded` has no `supersedes:` field pointing at its replacement. | Add `supersedes: [<successor-id>]`, or change the lifecycle to `deprecated` / `archived`. |
| `dark-public-function` | A `Function` whose crate is in `anchor_required_in` has neither a `///` doc-comment nor any `FUNCTION_MENTIONS` edge. | Add a doc-comment that mentions an ontology entity, or move the function out of the listed crate. |
| `dark-endpoint` | An `Endpoint` (axum / clap / mcp) has no `ENDPOINT_TOUCHES_ENTITY` edge — its handler doc-comment doesn't reach the ontology. | Add an entity reference to the handler's doc-comment, or set `covers:` on the handler crate's README. |
| `entity-coverage-gap` | An entity's `doc:func` ratio is strictly below `coverage_min_per_entity_doc_ratio`. | Author more covering docs, expand the entity's `synonyms:` list, or add the id to `coverage_entity_exempt`. |
| `unauthored-cluster` | LPA over Function+CALLS discovered a community of related functions whose `suggested_id` doesn't match any registered ontology entity. The code is organising around a concept the vocabulary hasn't captured yet. | `doc-linter cluster --write` scaffolds a candidate stub; review summary + synonyms, then `doc-linter cluster --promote <id>` flips it to `status: stable`. Or add the id as a synonym on an existing entity. Or add it to `cluster_lint.ignore`. |
| `coverage-below-min` | The corpus-wide function-reach percentage is below the `--coverage-min-global` flag (or `coverage_min_global` knob). | Close the gap by anchoring more functions to entities, or lower the threshold. |
| `orphan-entity` | An entity doc has zero inbound `covers:` or `[[entity-<id>]]` references (Roadmap-48 Rule C). Strict mode (`orphan_entity_requires_covers = true`) rejects wikilinks. | Author a narrative doc whose `covers:` includes this entity, or remove the entity if it's no longer used. |
| `missing-covers` | A `role: doc` declares no `covers:`. Opt-in via `require_covers_per_doc`. | Add `covers: [<entity-id>]` listing the entities this doc explains, or set `lifecycle: archived`. |
| `missing-bounded-context` | A `role: doc` has no `bounded_context:`. Opt-in via `require_bounded_context_per_doc`. | Add `bounded_context: <value>` to the frontmatter, or extend `bounded_context_paths` so it's inferred by path prefix. |
| `placeholder-entity` | The `example` entity scaffolded by `doc-linter init` is still present verbatim. | Replace the placeholder with a real entity, or delete `docs/ontology/entities/example.md` once the ontology has at least one authored entity. |
| `homepage-missing` | The configured `homepage_path` (default `MAP.md`) doesn't exist. Opt-in via `require_homepage`. | Run `doc-linter homepage --write` to generate it. |
| `homepage-stale` | The on-disk homepage file diverges from what `doc-linter homepage` would produce. | Run `doc-linter homepage --write`. |
| `missing-body-wikilink` | An entity declared in a doc's `covers:` isn't cited as `[[entity-<id>]]` in the body. Opt-in via `require_body_wikilink_per_cover`. | Add a `[[entity-<id>]]` mention to the body where the concept is first discussed. |
| `unused-bounded-context` | A `bounded-context` axis value is declared but no doc claims it. Opt-in via `require_bounded_context_usage`. | Author a doc with `bounded_context: <value>`, add the value to `bounded_context_usage_exempt`, or remove the value doc. |
